chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.com.au item nutrition (checked 1 Oct 2026). Extra patties, cheese, bacon and sauces use McDonald's energy for that ingredient; their protein, carbs and fat are estimated from the ingredient type

chains.name: KFC
chains.src: KFC Nutrition & Allergen Guide. Adding or taking off bacon & cheese is the difference between the same burger with and without it

chains.how: Official website item pages and nutrition guide PDFs
chains.name: Hungry Jack's
chains.src: hungryjacks.com.au item pages and Nutritional Guide PDFs (dipping sauces: Extra Condiments, 26 Sep 2026). Extra patties, cheese and bacon are the difference between two published burgers. Other add-ons and taking ingredients off use the energy Hungry Jack's ordering app gives for them (checked 14 Oct 2026); their protein, carbs and fat are estimated

chains.name: Subway
chains.src: Subway AU Nutrition Guide (May 2026) + Rice Bowls (Sep 2026)

chains.name: Guzman y Gomez
chains.src: GYG Nutrition Guide (18 Aug 2026), full menu. For custom GYG builds by ingredient, gygcalories.com (unofficial) is also handy

chains.name: Nando's
chains.src: Nando's online ordering nutrition panels (checked 14 Oct 2026), the figures the Nando's app and website show. Every protein, style, extra and removal has its own Nando's panel; swaps are the difference between the panels for that item.

chains.name: Oporto
chains.src: Oporto official menu nutrition panels. Add-ons use the energy Oporto's ordering menu gives for them (checked 14 Oct 2026), with a sauce's make-up from Oporto's dipping sauce and anything else's protein, carbs and fat estimated; taking an ingredient off uses one serve of it

chains.name: Red Rooster
chains.src: Red Rooster official menu nutrition panels. Items Red Rooster publishes no figures for are left out

chains.how: In-store menu board (photo) and official website
chains.name: Spud Bar
chains.src: Spud Bar in-store menu board (photo, Sep 2026) and spudbar.com.au. Spud Bar publishes protein and kJ only. Where the two differ, the in-store board is used

chains.name: Zambrero
chains.src: Zambrero Nutritional Information (14 July 2026). Burritos, bowls, nachos and tacos are without sauce; add a sauce separately. Three per-serve rows misprinted on the sheet are worked out from Zambrero's per-100 g figures

chains.name: Boost Juice
chains.src: Boost Juice Allergens & Nutritional Information (2026). Original 610 mL and medium 450 mL; Boost doesn't list boosters on their own

chains.name: Grill'd
chains.src: Grill'd ordering app nutrition panels (checked 14 Oct 2026), the figures the Grill'd app shows. Bun and patty swaps, bacon & cheese, egg & beetroot, and lettuce, carrot & egg mayo are the differences between burgers Grill'd publishes. Taking off herbed mayo, sweet chilli mayo, chipotle mayo or tomato relish is an estimate: Grill'd's figures for that sauce sold as a dip, for about 15 g of it. Other single ingredients can't be taken off, because Grill'd doesn't publish them

chains.name: Schnitz
chains.src: schnitz.com.au menu nutrition panels (checked 14 Oct 2026). Plates, salads, desserts, some tender snacks and the dunking cups list energy only, so they're left out until Schnitz publishes the rest. Figures printed as less than 1 g are left blank, or counted as 0 for protein, carbs and fat
